items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: Lockwood Lewis helped us get a job in a roadhouse up on the Ohio River.

ctx.x: So, there was a guy -- there was a fellow in town, a musician in town who at one time had been real popular, you know, around town. His name was Lockwood Lewis. Lockwood Lewis. This was a very beautiful man. This was a beautiful
person. Lockwood Lewis helped us get a job in a roadhouse up on the Ohio River. I think that's the Ohio River there in Louisville.
